Zip-code Level Analysis
   • Sample: Zipcodes with Safegraph foot traffic data

       For all the initial datasets that are more granular than the zip code level, we aggregate them
       up to the zip code level, and then merge the datasets at the zip code level. These datasets
       include:
   •   Foot traffic data
   •   Firm location data (merged by zipcode)
   •   Firm trade network data (merged by zipcode through Infogroup)
   •   Firm executive network data (merged by zipcode through Infogroup)
   •   Firm branch network data (merged by zipcode through Infogroup)
   •   Responsible investors data (merged by zipcode through Infogroup)
   •   ESG rating data (merged by zipcode through Infogroup)
   •   Essential industry data (data available at the NAICS_6 level, merged by zipcode through
       Infogroup at NAICS_6 level)
   •   Industry Teleworkability data (data available at the NAICS_3 level, merged by zipcode
       through CBP establishment data at NAICS_3 level)

       For all the initial datasets that are less granular than the zip code level, we disaggregate them
       and find the zip code and then merge the datasets at the zip code level. These datasets
       include:
   •   COVID-19 cases and deaths data
   •   COVID-19 policy data (county and state)
   •   COVID-19 policy data (city)
   •   City mayor data
   •   2020 Election data
   •   Social capital data
   •   Labor union data
   •   Labor unemployment data
   •   COVID-19 Lockdown Stringency Score data

       The following datasets are at the zip code level, so we directly merge them by zip code:
   •   ZIP code distance data
   •   American Community Survey.
